issues.description: Constructor signature mismatch for PersonService: the template and intended design use constructor injection (PersonService(PersonRepository)), but the solution replaces it with a no-argument constructor that sets the personRepository field to null. This structural change prevents proper dependency injection and would cause runtime null-pointer errors when the service methods call personRepository. It also contradicts the template implementation and the tests' expectation that PersonService has an injected repository.
issues.suggestedFix: Restore a constructor in the solution that accepts PersonRepository and assigns it to the final field (public PersonService(PersonRepository personRepository) { this.personRepository = personRepository; }), or alternatively use field/setter injection (e.g., annotate a non-final personRepository field with @Autowired). Ensure the constructor-based injection matches the template and supports the service methods using personRepository.
